description: Forty-four deterministic 96×96 pixel-art VFX for combat, elements, defense, support, status, portals, weather, movement, water interaction, sustained beams, environmental gameplay, impossible material transformations, telekinetic interaction, signal placement and collection, and sound-pressure feedback.

effects.use_case: A flagship contact hit with lightning, shock rings, smoke, sparks, and afterglow.
A fast melee arc with a sharp leading edge, directional sparks, and fractured decay.
A complete charge, travel, contact, impact, and decay lifecycle for a ranged spell.
An asymmetric fire blast with embers, smoke replacement, and persistent ground residue.
A radial ice area attack with crystalline fragments and expanding rings.
A liquid contact effect with arcing mass, droplets, splash, and grounded residue.
A longer ground attack with fissures, rising material, debris, and grounded decay.
A restorative support effect with luminous rings, upward motes, and a gentle release.
An inward-biased control effect with compression, negative space, and reverse-energy breakup.
A defensive contact and deflection read for guards, counters, and magical blocks.
A radiant burst with staggered rays, authored fragments, and deliberate breakup timing.
A directional fire effect with coherent tearing, aligned breakup, and clustered smoke.
A non-impact magical flourish with upward mass, designed motes, and fragment flakes.
A seamless dimensional gate loop with counter-rotating broken rings, a breathing aperture, and a compact core flare.
A seamless ground aura for poison buffs, debuffs, traps, and persistent status zones.
A compact utility puff for impacts, dodges, spawning, destruction, exhaust, and environmental reactions.
A seamless diagonal rain loop with separate depth bands and a low ground-mist pulse for outdoor scenes.
A lateral one-shot gust carrying autumn leaves for movement, ambience, and directional wind cues.
A grounded bilateral dust burst for landings, dashes, heavy steps, knockback, and environmental contact.
A snapped water-entry crown with bilateral sheets, concentric ripples, and ballistic droplets for jumps, projectiles, and creature breaches.
A seamless wash-and-recede shoreline strip with a persistent base film and broken foam edges for beaches, rivers, and flooded rooms.
A seamless guided drip cycle with staggered drops, a growing catch pool, and contact ripples for caves, ruins, pipes, and wet walls.
A converging pre-fire telegraph with contracting rings, inward visual pressure, and a crisp ready-state flash for beams, cannons, and charged attacks.
A seamless sustained beam with a stable readable body, regenerated energy lattice, and rotating source collar for continuous weapons and channelled magic.
A terminal beam stage with rapid retraction, a bright endpoint rupture, broken shock rings, and fragment decay for release, interruption, and overheat feedback.
Folded paper planes snap into a diagonal and leave two delayed curls.
A silver shell peels into ribbons, gathers into one bead, and drops.
A closed ember bud opens three curled petals around a hot detonation throat.
Gold stitches tighten a luminous wound into a small closing knot.
Held amber grains escape upward while fractured glass falls.
Three four-wing spirits trace unequal paths with offset glow and echoes.
Filings recirculate through a bent serrated spine and a copper return path.
An anchored root branches, cinches, and withdraws in staggered order.
Three ribbons weave an open knot with alternating over-under crossings.
Opposed copper facets snap into a notched contact, recoil and shed chips for locks, trap arming and mechanism engagement.
Cyan force ribbons catch loose material and pull it left for telekinetic capture confirmation.
A sustained counter-gravity field holds displaced material in a readable open center.
Stored weight drops into ground contact and rebounds outward for a telekinetic release payoff.
An amber seed lands, plants and sends an upward mint signal to confirm beacon or deployable placement.
Mint conduits carry amber packets through a fork to two receivers in a looping signal-transfer cycle.
Signals converge into a faceted reward that rises and clears to confirm resource collection.
Silence application, stealth suppression or an interrupt/cancel cue.
Looping directional echo probe: an outbound signal reflects and returns to its source.
Stored-sound release, guard break or silence-expiry payoff.
